doctor.title: trellis2-lowvram {version} environment check
doctor.result.warn: You can run it, but please review the [ !! ] items above.
doctor.result.fail: It cannot run as is. Follow the instructions under the [FAIL] items above.
fix.os.unsupported: Please run on Windows 10/11 or Ubuntu 22.04/24.04. macOS has no NVIDIA GPU and cannot be used.
check.gpu.missing: No NVIDIA graphics card was found. The PC may have no graphics card, an AMD or Intel one, or no NVIDIA driver installed.
fix.gpu.missing: You need a PC with an NVIDIA RTX 30, 40 or 50 series card. If it has one, install the driver from {url} and run this again.
check.gpu.too_old: Graphics card {name} (generation {cc}) is not supported. Cards older than the RTX 30 series cannot run the computations this tool uses.
fix.gpu.too_old: Please use a PC with an RTX 30, 40 or 50 series card.
check.vram.low: Graphics memory is {vram} GB. This tool targets 16GB; with less, generation may stop when memory runs out (experimental).
fix.vram.low: You can continue. If it stops, set quality to 'Fast', reduce texture size to 1024 and try again.
check.driver.old: NVIDIA driver {driver} is too old. This tool needs a driver that supports CUDA 12.8 or newer (version 570+); the current one supports up to CUDA {driver_cuda}.
fix.driver.old: Pick your card model at {url}, install the latest driver, then restart the PC.
check.ram.low: System memory (RAM) is {ram} GB. 32GB is recommended. Models are moved between the graphics card and RAM, so less RAM can make it slow or stop.
fix.ram.low: You can continue. Close browser tabs and other programs while it runs.
check.ram.too_low: System memory (RAM) is only {ram} GB, not enough to hold the models.
fix.ram.too_low: Please run on a PC with at least 16GB of RAM. 32GB is recommended.
check.disk.low: Only {free} GB free at {path}. The program and models need about {need} GB (estimate).
check.disk.too_low: Not enough space at {path}: {free} GB free. The program and models need about {need} GB (estimate).
fix.disk.low: Delete files you do not need, or move this folder to a drive with more space and install again.
check.path.non_ascii: The install location {path} contains non-English characters. Some components can fail in such paths.
check.path.space: The install location {path} contains spaces. Some components can fail in such paths.
check.path.long: The install location {path} is long (over {max} characters). Installation may fail because of the Windows path length limit.
fix.path.move: Move this folder to a short English path such as C:\trellis2-lowvram and install again.
check.torch.ok: PyTorch {torch} (CUDA {cuda}) can use the graphics card.
check.torch.missing: PyTorch is not installed or could not be loaded. ({err})
check.torch.no_cuda: PyTorch {torch} cannot use the graphics card. The driver may be too old or the install may be broken.
fix.torch.no_cuda: First update the NVIDIA driver and restart the PC. If it still fails, run install again.
fix.reinstall: Run install again. If the same problem repeats, attach the newest log file in the logs folder to an issue.
check.attn.none: Could not load the attention component (xformers). 3D generation cannot run without it.
check.hf.no_token: No Hugging Face token. Downloading the DINOv3 image encoder requires a Hugging Face account and approved access.
check.hf.bad_token: The Hugging Face token is not valid. It may have been copied wrongly or deleted.
check.hf.not_approved: DINOv3 access is not approved yet. You have not requested it, or Meta has not approved it yet. Request page: {url}
check.hf.network: Could not reach Hugging Face, so DINOv3 access could not be checked.
fix.hf.login: Run trellis2 login and follow the steps. (install runs it for you at the end)
fix.hf.network: Check your internet connection and try again. On a school or office network, make sure huggingface.co is not blocked.
fix.hf.wait: Approval is done by people and can take hours to days. When you get the approval email, run install again or run trellis2 download.
login.intro: The DINOv3 image encoder requires approval from Meta. You only need to do these three steps once.
login.step1: 1. Create a Hugging Face account (skip if you have one): {url}
login.step2: 2. While logged in, submit the access request form on this page and wait for approval: {url}
login.step3: 3. Create a token with 'Read' permission on this page and copy it: {url}
login.prompt: Paste the token and press Enter (it will not be shown):
login.empty: The token is empty. Please run this again.
login.saved: Saved the token inside this install folder.
download.need_access: DINOv3 access is not confirmed, so models were not downloaded. Run this again after approval: {url}
download.start: Downloading models. The first download is over 10GB and takes a while. If it is interrupted, run it again to resume. Location: {path}
error.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please attach this log file to an issue: {log}
install.retry: After fixing it, run install again. Finished steps and downloaded files are skipped.
install.step2.fail: [Step 2: PC check] This PC has a problem that prevents running. Fix the items under the [FAIL] lines above first. If you installed a new driver, restart the PC before running install again.
install.step3.fail: [Step 3: TRELLIS.2 source] Could not download from github.com. Check: (1) your internet connection (2) on a school or office network, that github.com is not blocked (3) free disk space.
install.step4.fail: [Step 4: Python packages] This step downloads several GB and fails most often. Check: (1) the internet did not drop; running again resumes the download (2) at least 30GB of free disk space (3) your antivirus did not delete or block files; if it did, add this folder to its exclusions (4) the folder path has no non-English characters or spaces.
install.step5.fail: [Step 5: 3D processing components] Could not download the prebuilt files from GitHub, or a downloaded file was damaged. Check: (1) your internet connection and access to github.com (2) your antivirus is not blocking .whl files. Running again downloads damaged files anew.
install.step6.fail: [Step 6: Models] Could not download the model files (over 10GB). Check: (1) your internet connection and access to huggingface.co (2) free disk space (3) DINOv3 access is approved. After approval you can just run trellis2 download again.
download.failed: The model download was interrupted or failed. Check your internet connection and access to huggingface.co, then run trellis2 download again. Partial files resume.
download.no_space: Not enough disk space to download the models. Free up space on the drive with {path}, then run trellis2 download again.
install.log: If it still fails, please attach this log file to a GitHub issue: {log}
ext.not_ready: Prebuilt 3D processing components for this operating system are not available in this version yet. This is not something you can fix. Please run update later to get a newer version.

share.readme:
trellis2-lowvram models folder

This folder holds the model weights trellis2-lowvram uses (TRELLIS.2, DINOv3, BiRefNet).

How to use
1. Not installed yet: put this whole folder into the trellis2-lowvram install folder (where install.bat is) and run install.bat. The installer takes the models from here, so no Hugging Face token or DINOv3 approval is needed.
2. Already installed: in the install folder, run trellis2 import-models <path to this folder>.

Licenses
- DINOv3: Meta's DINOv3 License (DINOv3-LICENSE.md). When you pass it on, include this license copy. No prohibited uses such as military or weapons, follow applicable laws (including trade controls), and credit DINOv3 in publications.
- TRELLIS.2 (microsoft/TRELLIS.2-4B, microsoft/TRELLIS-image-large): MIT
- BiRefNet (ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet): MIT
- Textures in the resulting GLB are baked with nvdiffrast, which is licensed for non-commercial research/evaluation only. See THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md in trellis2-lowvram.
